text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you catch the Oka Sho?
That Hishi Amazon girl was really good!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it, I know her!
Her running style is a bit rough around the edges, but it's really good.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"If Narita Brian is on the Triple Crown route,
then Hishi Amazon would be on the Triple Tiara route, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the number of fans in the stands
was gradually increasing as well.
Amidst all this, Hishi Amazonâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, the tension is thick! Every single one of them
is dying to get their hands on the Tiara, huh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian took the first crown.
And not just that, she won in record time.
I cannot afford to run half-heartedly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: At the Oaks, I'm gonna leave everyone in the dust with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's powerful declaration
echoes through the underground horse path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The battle for the second crown of the Tiara route begins now—!
